08/06.10.2025

This matter has been taken out of turn on mention as it has been pointed out that
the provisional bail granted to the petitioner by order dated 8th April, 2025 is going to expire on 8th
October, 2025.

2.  Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that a co-ordinate Bench of this Court has directed the petitioner to pay a sum of Rs.50,000/- to opposite party No.2 by way of victim compensation under Section 357-A of Cr.P.C. and in view of that the provisional bail has been granted.

He further submits that the petitioner has been convicted and directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment of six months and fine amount of Rs.1,000/- for the offence punishable under Section 279 of Indian Penal Code and in default of fine he shall further undergo simple imprisonment for one --1-- Criminal Revision No. 191 of 2025 month and further sentenced to undergo rigorous Aziz Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59868693/
1 imprisonment of two years and fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence punishable under Section 304A of IPC and in default of payment of fine he shall further undergo simple imprisonment of one month and the learned Court further sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of three months and fine of Rs.500/- for the offence punishable under Section 184 of Motor Vehicle Act and in default of payment of fine he shall further undergo simple imprisonment of 15 days.

sentences.text: He then submits that further direction is also there that the sentences will run concurrently.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party No.2 submits that Rs.50,000/- has been deposited before the learned Court, however, the said amount has not been withdrawn by the opposite party No.2 as enquiry is being made by the learned Court for withdrawal of the said amount.

4. In view of the above and considering that the petitioner has already complied the earlier order and he is on provisional bail, as such provisional bail granted earlier by order dated 8th March,
2025 is hereby confirmed.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.)
 Dated 06.10.2025  Sangam/
